instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show the plan, card and receipts of this purchase", and give it subscription_id and subject_email (the signed-in buyer's verified email).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:show-one-purchase-plan-card-and-receipts and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. To change the card, the plan or cancel, the buyer's button runs tool:open-the-billing-page-for-one-purchase-and-show-the-card with the matching flow; Stripe's page then asks the buyer to confirm.
